About Our Internship ProgramZoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox's mission.

Job DescriptionThe Software Systems organization builds the foundations that the autonomy and product software run on, and the systems that verify that software. Interns gain an end-to-end view of the Zoox software stack while solving a focused problem on one of the teams below. Interns in this pipeline may be considered for opportunities across a range of teams, including:
Systems Engineering: Builds simulation-based and model-based checks that catch software defects early in the development pipeline.
Software Performance: Profiles and optimizes runtime latency and resource use across the stack.
Software Core: Develops the middleware, networking and sensor tooling that connect vehicle software components.
Product Security: Strengthens the security of the vehicle and its software, including remote attestation.
Simulation: Builds machine learning-based sensor simulation, reconstruction and world models used to test the driving software.


In this Role, You Will...:
• Design and implement software for a defined project, such as a profiling tool, a network scheduler, an automated checker or a simulation component 

• Evaluate design options through experiments, benchmarks or literature review 

• Test and document your work so the team can adopt it 

• Present results to engineering stakeholders at the end of the summer

Requirements:
• Currently working towards a B.S., M.S., Ph.D., or advanced degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related engineering program 

• Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028, and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship 

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox

Qualifications:
• Experience programming in C++ or Python 

• Understanding of operating systems, networking or computer architecture fundamentals 

• Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, unit testing, CI) 

• Enthusiasm for automotive technologies and robotics 

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Bonus Qualifications:
• Experience with simulation frameworks used in robotics 

• Experience with performance profiling, low-level systems programming or network protocols 

• Machine learning, security or 3D graphics experience, depending on team

Compensation
The monthly salary range for this position is $6,500 to $9,500. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education. Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a relocation stipend. 


About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.
fit_why: Systems/robotics internship; strong C++/Python fit, but embedded/robotics gap

About Our Internship Program
Zoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox's mission.
 
Job Description
Autonomy Software builds the software that lets the Zoox robotaxi perceive its surroundings, predict what others will do, and plan and control the vehicle with no one behind the wheel. Interns join one of the teams below, work with a mentor on an open research or engineering question, and see a direct path from their work to the system that runs on Zoox vehicles and in simulation.

Interns in this pipeline may be considered for opportunities across a range of teams, including:
Autonomy Behaviors: Owns the decision-making, planning & control modules, which decide how the vehicle drives. Projects include machine-learned planning, long-horizon reasoning, configurable driving styles, freeway driving and new vehicle platform bring-up.
Perception: Gives the vehicle an understanding of its surroundings using camera, lidar, radar and audio. Projects include object detection and tracking, multimodal foundation models, scene understanding, occupancy and 3D mapping.
Guidance & Routing: Works on route-level planning and offline mapping, including the mission planner, map data delivery and road network tools.
Collision Avoidance System: Runs an independent safety layer with its own perception and planning. This team also works on the evaluation and data tooling for verification.


In this Role, You Will...:
• Work on interesting research or advanced engineering problems that could have the potential to revolutionize the existing Autonomy Software stack. 

• Design, build and evaluate state-of-the-art algorithms or machine learning models for a real autonomous driving system. 

• Train and test models on large-scale driving and simulation data, and analyze failure modes to measure improvements. 

• Write production-quality C++ and Python that goes through code review. 

• Present your results to your team and at the end-of-summer project showcase, and contribute to publishable research where the project allows.

Requirements:
• Currently working towards a M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related engineering program 

• Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028, and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship 

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox

Qualifications:
• Currently working towards a M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related engineering program 

• Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python 

• Solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms 

• Experience with PyTorch, Jax, Tensorflow, Numpy 

• Experience in at least one of machine learning, computer vision, motion planning, controls, prediction or mapping 

• Clear communication of technical results

Bonus Qualifications:
• Publications in top ML or robotics conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA) 

• Experience with autonomous driving or learned robotic planning 

• Experience with large-scale, multi-node training workloads

Compensation
The monthly salary range for this position is $6,500 to $10,500. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education. Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a relocation stipend.

Our industry-specific business management solution is engineered to address real-world needs—featuring intelligent workflows and market-leading usability that enable companies to manage risk, anticipate disruption, and seize new opportunities. Our principled business practices, growth-friendly licensing, and flexible deployment options put organizations in control of their own future. Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 
 
Our Summer Internship program is a wonderful opportunity for Fall and Spring graduates to immerse themselves in an innovative and mission driven culture. Our paid internship program will provide you with hands on mentorship, an opportunity to add real contribution to our company via your internship project, and a possible job offer at the end. You will have the chance to make lifelong friendships, expand your network, and learn all about what it's like to work in a high-growth, fast scaling tech unicorn. You'll take part in company sponsored events and enjoy exploring a new city. Read on below to learn more about this unique internship!


 
 


About the Role:
Shield AI's Software Development Engineer Intern program spans engineers who design, build, and test the code that powers our autonomous systems — from user-facing applications and embedded flight software to machine learning models and the underlying systems platforms that tie it all together. Over 10–12 weeks, interns work alongside full-time engineers to analyze requirements, write and debug production-quality code, and ship a real feature or capability using our standard Agile development practices.

 Example Intern Projects 

• 
 Applications: Build a new feature or internal tool (web, mobile, or desktop) that streamlines a mission-planning or fleet-management workflow.

• 
 Firmware/Embedded: Develop and debug embedded C/C++ code for a flight controller or sensor module, including bring-up and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

• 
 Machine Learning: Train, evaluate, and integrate a perception or decision-making model (e.g., object detection, sensor fusion) into an autonomy pipeline.

• 
 Systems Development: Extend a platform tool, API, or data pipeline that supports autonomy software, simulation, or cloud infrastructure.

Required Qualifications:
• 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• 
 Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., C, C++, Python, Java, or JavaScript)

• 
 Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

• 
 Experience writing, testing, and debugging code, whether through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships

• 
 Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows

• 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous requirements into working code

• 
 Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:
• 
 Exposure to mobile or web application frameworks and full-stack development

• 
 Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, real-time operating systems, or assembly-level debugging

• 
 Coursework or projects involving machine learning, statistics, probability theory, or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)

• 
 Experience with cloud platforms, databases, networking, or distributed systems

• 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• 
 Prior internship, research, or club/competition experience in robotics, autonomy, or aerospace applications

• 
 Interest in or exposure to the defense, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry

Your Opportunity as a Data Science Intern 
 As a Data Science Intern on our Data Science team, you will play a key role in supporting data-driven decision-making across sales, marketing  and other business-critical processes. This is an opportunity to apply your analytical, statistical, and technical skills in a real-world environment, directly impacting sales strategies.
  
 Location: Remote
  
 Work Arrangements: Remote
  
 In this role, you will: 
 
• Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources using statistical and programming techniques. 
• Interpret complex data to generate actionable insights and effectively communicate findings through dashboards, visualizations, and presentations. 
• Apply statistical modeling and machine learning techniques (both supervised and unsupervised) to solve real-world business problems in the sales domain. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support issue resolution, identify proactive improvement opportunities, and contribute to business outcomes. 
• Enhance your technical, analytical, and professional skills while building meaningful relationships across the organization.  
 What we are looking for: 
 
• Enrolled in a graduate program (MS, PhD) in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 
• Strong foundational knowledge in statistical modeling, machine learning (e.g., regression, classification, clustering), forecasting, and data analysis. 
• Proficiency in at least one programming language used in data science (e.g., Python, R, SQL). 
• Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, ggplot) and an ability to tell compelling stories with data. 
• Relevant coursework completed, including but not limited to: 
• Statistical Methods (e.g., Applied Statistics, Regression Analysis, Bayesian Statistics) 
• Machine Learning (e.g., Supervised and Unsupervised Learning, Neural Networks, Deep Learning) 
• Programming and Data Wrangling (e.g., Python for Data Science, Data Manipulation with R, SQL for Data Analysis) 
• Data Visualization and Communication (e.g., Data Storytelling, Advanced Visualization Techniques) 
• Domain-Specific or Advanced Topics (e.g., Time Series Analysis, Forecasting, Optimization Techniques, Econometrics) 
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to “connect-the-dots” across data and business needs. 
• Good communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 Application Period: 
 
• Application period closes on December 7th, 2026 
 Why Choose the J.M. Smucker Company’s Internship Program?

 Along with engaging work, we offer a variety of benefits to ensure your internship is both rewarding and memorable. These include:

 Experience an internship where you can learn, grow, and lead — all while being part of something special at Smucker.
